explanation: The claim Thailand pressed in 1940 is the loss of 1893, and the war’s own § Background opens on it: “The events of Franco-Siamese Crisis of 1893 (Rattanakosin Era R.S.112) and Franco-Siamese Treaty of 1907 ended with Siam losing the territories of Laos and Cambodia to France. The crisis was seen as a national humiliation according to ‘Lost Territories’ narrative.” The territories fought over in 1940 are those territories.
